entries.content: Magic divides into eight recognized schools. These define the nature of the spell effect. Mages study these paths to control arcane forces.
Spells exist across five power tiers. Minor spells require DC eight. Apprentice needs eleven. Journeyman needs fourteen. Expert demands seventeen. Master requires twenty.
Casting requires an Intelligence check. You roll a d20 plus your Intelligence modifier against the spell DC. Success manifests the magic safely.
Spell Absorption nullifies incoming magic. The chance equals Intelligence plus Willpower divided by two. The maximum chance caps at seventy five percent.
The Spellmaker allows custom magical creation. You describe your desired effect explicitly. The system automatically assigns the appropriate school and tier.
Magical fumbles cause dangerous backfires. A natural one on casting twists the spell wildly. You suffer minor unintended effects or localized damage.
The Mage class receives natural casting advantages. They roll with advantage regarding all spell casting checks. They command magic effortlessly.
Destruction magic harms enemies directly. It manifests as fire or frost or lightning. The effects are violent and spectacular.
Restoration magic mends physical wounds. It cures lingering diseases. It glows with a soothing golden light.
